#include <dx/linalg.h>

using namespace dx::linalg;

ByteAddressBuffer input_0 : register(t0);
ByteAddressBuffer state_0 : register(t1);
ByteAddressBuffer state_1 : register(t2);
ByteAddressBuffer state_2 : register(t3);

RWByteAddressBuffer output_0 : register(u0);

static const uint IN_C = 128;
static const uint OUT_C = 128;
static const uint IN_H = 360;
static const uint IN_W = 640;
static const uint OUT_H = 180;
static const uint OUT_W = 320;
static const uint K_TOTAL = 1152;
static const uint K_TILE = 64;
static const uint OC_TILE = 16;
static const uint OC_BLOCKS = 8;
static const uint SPATIAL = OUT_H * OUT_W;
static const uint TOTAL_JOBS = SPATIAL * OC_BLOCKS;

typedef Matrix<ComponentType::F16, 16, 64, MatrixUse::A, MatrixScope::Thread> WFrag16x64;

float16_t LoadInputHalf(uint c, uint y, uint x)
{
    uint elem = (c * IN_H + y) * IN_W + x;
    return input_0.Load<float16_t>(elem * 2);
}

float16_t LoadBiasHalf(uint oc)
{
    return state_2.Load<float16_t>(oc * 2);
}

float16_t InputForKNoBounds(uint kk, uint cy, uint cx)
{
    uint ic = kk / 9;
    uint rem = kk - ic * 9;
    uint kh = rem / 3;
    uint kw = rem - kh * 3;

    uint iy = cy + kh - 1;
    uint ix = cx + kw - 1;

    return LoadInputHalf(ic, iy, ix);
}

float16_t InputForK(uint kk, int cy, int cx)
{
    uint ic = kk / 9;
    uint rem = kk - ic * 9;
    uint kh = rem / 3;
    uint kw = rem - kh * 3;

    int iy = cy + (int)kh - 1;
    int ix = cx + (int)kw - 1;

    if (iy < 0 || iy >= (int)IN_H || ix < 0 || ix >= (int)IN_W)
    {
        return (float16_t)0.0h;
    }

    return LoadInputHalf(ic, (uint)iy, (uint)ix);
}

[WaveSize(32)]
[numthreads(256, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 dispatchThreadID : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    uint job = dispatchThreadID.x;
    if (job >= TOTAL_JOBS)
    {
        return;
    }

    uint ocBlock = job & 7;
    uint spatial = job >> 3;

    uint ox = spatial % OUT_W;
    uint oy = spatial / OUT_W;
    uint ocBase = ocBlock * OC_TILE;

    bool interior = (oy > 0 && oy < (OUT_H - 1) && ox > 0 && ox < (OUT_W - 1));

    vector<float, 16> bias;
    vector<float, 16> poolAcc;
    [unroll]
    for (uint oi = 0; oi < 16; ++oi)
    {
        bias[oi] = (float)LoadBiasHalf(ocBase + oi);
        poolAcc[oi] = 0.0f;
    }

    [unroll]
    for (uint py = 0; py < 2; ++py)
    {
        [unroll]
        for (uint px = 0; px < 2; ++px)
        {
            uint ucy = oy * 2 + py;
            uint ucx = ox * 2 + px;
            int cy = (int)ucy;
            int cx = (int)ucx;

            vector<float, 16> acc;
            [unroll]
            for (uint oi = 0; oi < 16; ++oi)
            {
                acc[oi] = bias[oi];
            }

            [unroll]
            for (uint k0 = 0; k0 < K_TOTAL; k0 += K_TILE)
            {
                vector<float16_t, 64> xFrag;

                [branch]
                if (interior)
                {
                    [unroll]
                    for (uint ki = 0; ki < K_TILE; ++ki)
                    {
                        xFrag[ki] = InputForKNoBounds(k0 + ki, ucy, ucx);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    [unroll]
                    for (uint ki = 0; ki < K_TILE; ++ki)
                    {
                        xFrag[ki] = InputForK(k0 + ki, cy, cx);
                    }
                }

                uint weightByteOffset = ((ocBase * K_TOTAL) + k0) * 2;
                WFrag16x64 wFrag = WFrag16x64::Load<MatrixLayout::RowMajor>(
                    state_1,
                    weightByteOffset,
                    K_TOTAL * 2);

                vector<float16_t, 16> delta16 = Multiply<float16_t>(wFrag, xFrag);

                [unroll]
                for (uint oi = 0; oi < 16; ++oi)
                {
                    acc[oi] += (float)delta16[oi];
                }
            }

            [unroll]
            for (uint oi = 0; oi < 16; ++oi)
            {
                poolAcc[oi] += max(acc[oi], 0.0f);
            }
        }
    }

    [unroll]
    for (uint oi = 0; oi < 16; ++oi)
    {
        uint oc = ocBase + oi;
        uint outElem = (oc * OUT_H + oy) * OUT_W + ox;
        float v = poolAcc[oi] * 0.25f;
        output_0.Store<float16_t>(outElem * 2, (float16_t)v);
    }
}
